aero_player_tilt.configuration.title: Aeronautics Player Tilt Config
aero_player_tilt.configuration.enabled.t: Turns the mod on or off.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.rotateCam: Tilts the camera with the body. Off keeps the camera aligned with the world.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.gripSlope: Magnetic boots are on — they already hold you to any face.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.minNormal: The steepest floor you can still stand on.
A rule of this world, sent to everyone who joins. Turned on with enforceMaxTilt in the world's config.
Set by the server, so nobody can lean further than anyone else.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.deckGravi: Which way you fall above a tilted sub-level.
Set by the server for everyone.
Down is the world's own. A jump lands downhill of where you took off.
Down is the sub-level's. A jump lands where you took off, as on flat ground.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.tiltMulti: How much of the tilt the body takes. 0 = stay upright.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.smoothSpe: How fast the body leans onto the floor under it. 0 = snap, higher = lazier.
How fast the body straightens up again once it is off the sub-level.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.takeoverT: How long the camera takes to move onto the body. 0 = at once, with a jolt.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.remoteSmo: Smoothing of other players' tilt. 0 = off.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.holdTicks: How long the tilt survives with no floor found.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.airborneH: Keeps the tilt while you are in the air over your sub-level, so a jump does not straighten you. Needs landing prediction.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.deckCarry: How long a sub-level carries you while it only touches you from the side.
Tilt only on sub-levels at least this heavy.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.gateBlock: Tilt only on sub-levels with at least this many blocks.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.gateLengt: Tilt only on sub-levels at least this long.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.gateHeigh: Tilt only on sub-levels at least this tall.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.gateWidth: Tilt only on sub-levels at least this wide.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.dropCache: Forget the sub-level as soon as every ray misses.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.disableOn: Do not tilt while flying in Creative or Spectator
aero_player_tilt.configuration.stickToDe: Count as standing while there is floor within a step below. Stops the sliding on slopes.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.turnWithD: On a spinning sub-level, keep facing the same way relative to it, not to the world.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.deckMomen: Makes a fast-spinning sub-level comfortable to walk on. 1.0 = with the spin, 0 = off.
Sable: Sure Footing does the same (rotate_ground_velocity). Leave one of the two on.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.zoneLinge: How long the vessel keeps you after you leave sub-level hitbox.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.zoneReach: How far outside the hull still counts as inside, in blocks.
The sub-level decides as long as you are inside it. Best while building.
The sub-level decides only where the rays find nothing.
"Disable on flying" below switches this off while you fly.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.disableOn: This switches the tilt inside a sub-level off while you fly.
How much a sub-level you are INSIDE decides which way is up.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.count.too: How many rays sample the floor.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.radius.to: How wide the ring of rays spreads, in blocks.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.downLengt: How far down to look for a surface.
Where the rays start, measured from the feet.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.magneticB: Any face becomes your floor — walls, ceilings. Jump again in the air to let go.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.magneticR: How far below your feet to look for a surface.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.magneticL: How close an edge has to be before the body leans over it. 0 — no lean.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.magneticP: How hard the boots press into the face. Doesn't affect jumps.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.magneticS: How long the body takes to turn onto a new face. 0 — instant.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.blendFoot: Read the floor from everything underfoot, not just one sub-level. Stops flickering.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.footingGr: How far below the boots a surface still counts as your floor.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.footingMa: Standing across two sub-levels, how much more of your weight the other one has to take before it becomes the one holding you.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.footingDw: How many ticks it has to keep that lead. Together the two stop a seam throwing you between the sub-levels.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.predictLa: Turn towards the floor you are going to land on during the flight.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.predictHo: How far ahead a jump is simulated.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.landingLe: Finish the turn this many ticks before landing.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.entityTil: Set by the server: nothing is sent for a mob's tilt, so the host decides.
Yours only: this server has no mod.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.rays.tool: Draw the floor rays and what they hit.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.debugMess: Write the tilt's log lines to the console.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.tiltSyncP: Panel comparing body tilt with Camera Sync's camera tilt.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.frameTrac: Log every frame around a landing or a camera jump.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.keybind.c: Key is already in use, may cause conflicts!
aero_player_tilt.configuration.btn.reset: Reset this page. Hold Shift to unlock the button.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.hardLimit: One or more parameters are invalid
disconnect.aero_player_tilt.server_missi:
This server does not have Aeronautics Player Tilt.

The mod is required on the server as well as on your client: the tilt turns your hitbox, and only a server that knows about it can play fair with everyone else.

Ask the server owner to install it:
https://modrinth.com/project/aeronautics-player-tilt
screen.aero_player_tilt.config_reset.bod: Your config file is outdated and may cause issues.
aero_player_tilt.configuration.minNormal: Past 37° you slide off. Turn on "Sticky tilt" below.
